title: ID0432293-DC/Si-D/FR- [MP / R4 170001747] EVSE Malfunctions
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
We are experiencing recurring malfunctions on one of our EV
charging stations.
Station details:
• Model: SICHARGE D MP/R4170001747
• Location: AIRE DES FRÈRES LUMIÈRE
• Issue observed on connectors: 1 and 2
Issue description:
• Frequent service interruptions and charge failures.
• When a vehicle is connected to connector 1 or 2, the connector
immediately goes out of service.
• Charging sessions cannot be initiated reliably
